Cedar field silvered; a splash band darkens the courses over the canopy cap. Algae line under the canopy drip.
Tree ≈ 3 m; bed in full cover, bloom March–October. Forebay sediment ≈ 15 mm.
Even mid-silver cedar; powder-coated door chalks lighter than the PVDF liners. ZIP fabric and motor replaced.
Tree ≈ 5 m shades the west glass late afternoon. Rain-garden sediment ≈ 45 mm, drain-down 12–24 h.
Cedar 140,138,133 with 1–3 mm erosion; liners and cap renewed with the cladding. Track renewed via the 316 floor plate.
Tree ≈ 6 m mature. Sediment ≈ 90 mm: strip the top 50–100 and replant. Granite relaid, not replaced.
